question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Sagacious
solution:
The correct answer is '**Judicious**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate synonym of the given word '**Sagacious**' is '**Judicious**'.
 
• **Sagacious**: having or showing good judgment and understanding. (सही निर्णय क्षमता या समझ वाला; बुद्धिमान, दूरदर्शी, विवेकशील)
 
 
• *Example: The army had appeared a hard master when it ent its strength to a wise and **sagacious** rule.*
 
 
 
• **Judicious**: (used about a decision or an action) sensible and carefully considered; showing good judgement. [(निर्णय या कार्रवाई) बुद्धिमत्तापूर्ण और सुविचारित; विवेकपूर्ण विवेक-सम्‍मत]
 
 
• *Example: We should listen to the **judicious** opinion of that old man.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Judicious.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Delicious**: having a very pleasant taste or smell. (स्‍वादिष्‍ट या सुगंधित)
 
• **Precious**: of great value (usually because it is rare or difficult to find). [क़ीमती, बहुमूल्‍य (सामान्‍यतः दुर्लभ होने के कारण)]
 
• **Malicious**: intended to harm or upset other people. (अन्य लोगों को नुकसान पहुंचाने या परेशान करने का इरादा)
